message:
fix(keepalive-multi r2): a kept PC's card says "1분 미만" in its last minute instead of counting seconds

The per-second countdown re-bound the PC list every second in a PC's last minute; the
list never settled (on the 45 s test policy uiautomator took ~70 s per read, km2_ttl_r1).
A card now changes at most once a minute: "5분" ... "1분", then "1분 미만".
km2_ttl_r2 (TEST policy park limit 45 s, fixture APK 7b689f23): 15/15 -- B parked expires
on its own limit (45.45 s from its BeginPark) while A is on screen, A untouched; B after
that is a new connection (handle 2 -> 3); A reused after its FIRST park would have
expired (142 s) because showing it again started a new limit (37 s).
gradle assembleDebug testDebugUnitTest 213/0 (plain e05cb5cc).
